bands.heading: Four things to remember
bands.deck: AI generates, works from what you give it, and still needs you

nodes.label: Generates, not guarantees
nodes.note: A fluent answer is not a verified answer. Ask it to separate fact from interpretation.

nodes.label: Context is its working desk
nodes.note: If it is not on the desk it may not be used. Give the smallest complete context.

nodes.label: Grounding uses approved sources
nodes.note: Name exactly which sources it may use, and forbid inventing what is missing.

nodes.label: Review scales with consequence
nodes.note: The more an output can affect a person, the less autonomy the AI should have.

nodes.label: Situation

nodes.label: Task
nodes.note: What Joyia should actually do

nodes.label: Source
nodes.note: Which information it may use — and only that

nodes.label: Constraints

nodes.label: Output and checks

bands.heading: One message becomes several communications

bands.heading: One spreadsheet becomes decision-ready insight

nodes.label: Validate first
nodes.note: Flag inconsistent periods, missing data and small samples

nodes.label: Define the metric
nodes.note: Voluntary leavers over average headcount — stated, not guessed

nodes.label: Calculation table

nodes.label: Observations and questions

nodes.label: Dashboard

nodes.label: Reviewer challenges it

nodes.label: What is missing?

nodes.label: Separate

bands.heading: The more an output can affect a person, the less autonomy the AI gets
bands.deck: Where it may generate freely, assist, or stay out of the decision

nodes.label: Green — generate freely
items: AI role: generate and transform, then normal review

nodes.label: Yellow — assist with checks
items: AI role: approved data and sources, explicit human review

nodes.label: Red — human decides
items: AI role: none in the decision. Human-led throughout.
